ja: ガンプラ最高峰ＰＧ（パーフェクトグレード）からダブルオーライザー登場。
ＧＮドライヴは組立済みで付属する両肩のＧＮドライヴは内部でフライホイールが回転しながら点灯する。
ＧＮコンデンサー（肩・肘・手首・ヒザ全身８ヶ所）に新設計のクラッチ機構を内蔵し、大型の武器も腕が下がらずガッチリと保持。
新解釈を加えた内部骨格のディテールを完全再現。
脚部上下スイング機構によりアクションポーズの可動性が大幅に向上。
オーライザーの新たな追加武装として４種類の武器類が付属。
en: • GUNPLA Double Aurizer from the highest PG (Perfect Grade) is now available.
• The GN drive is pre-assembled and comes with the GN drive on both shoulders, which lights up while the fly wheel rotates inside.
• GN condenser (8 places on the shoulders, elbows, wrists, and knees) has a newly designed clutch mechanism built in, and large weapons are held tightly without lowering the arms.
• The details of the internal skeleton with a new interpretation have been completely redone.
• The leg up-and-down swing mechanism greatly improves the mobility of the action pose.
• 4 types of weapons are included as new additional weapons for the Auriser.

• Various weapons are fully equipped Molded ×58, Foil Seal ×1, Tetoron Seal ×1, GUNDAM DECAL ×1, Hologram Sheet ×1, Assembly Instructions ×1, GN Drive (Assembled, Sample Battery Included) ×2, Head LED ×1, Head Sample Battery (LR41) ×2
